tour.title: Look around
tour.body: Drag beside the cube to turn the view and see it from any side.

tour.title: Turn a layer
tour.body: Swipe across the stickers, or press a key: every face turn has one.

tour.title: Type an algorithm
tour.body: Type moves in notation to set up a case or watch an algorithm played.

tour.title: Scramble and reset
tour.body: Scramble gives you a random state and Reset goes back to solved. Undo and redo are here too.

tour.title: Keyboard controls
tour.body: See every key, or map your own. Press ? any time.

greetings.line: Try R U R' U' six times: the cube comes back solved.

tips: R U R' U' six times brings the cube back to solved.
Solves here are never saved, so experiment freely.
Set up any case by typing its algorithm and pressing Set up case.
